name: Brine concentration and selective salt recovery
applications: reducing ZLD energy cost by pre-concentrating
salt products from desalination and industrial brine
principle: Steps ahead of full ZLD: high-pressure RO/HERO, membrane distillation or electrodialysis reversal push brine from a typical 4-8% up to 15-25% salt, cutting evaporator duty; nanofiltration fractionation or selective crystallisation then splits mixed brine into saleable single salts (NaCl, Na2SO4) instead of a mixed waste.

process_steps.name: Concentration
equipment: high-pressure RO / HERO / membrane distillation / EDR

costs.metric: levelised cost of water, single-stage mechanical vapour compression
costs.unit: USD per m3 of product water
costs.basis: Feed 25-150 g/kg, recovery 40-80%, annualised capital plus operating cost. Brine concentration by MVC; per m3 of product, not per m3 of feed.

source.note: Tucker et al., Component innovations for lower cost mechanical vapor compression, OSTI 2476217 (2024): single-stage MVC LCOW, read 2026-11-16
